title: DeFrame: Debiasing Large Language Models Against Framing Effects
findings: Religion was one of seven demographic categories evaluated for bias using the BBQ benchmark. The results showed that LLMs exhibit significant bias and framing disparity concerning religious stereotypes. For example, under negative framings, bias scores were substantially higher. This disparity was found to persist even in larger-scale models, where disability and religion categories consistently showed large framing disparities.
references: Zeyuan Allen-Zhu and Yuanzhi Li. Physics of language models: Part 3.2, knowledge manipulation, 2024. URL https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.14402.
